tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rim lnga dmar khrid kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang*// de'i sras byang sems blo gros rin chen dang*// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa ma taṃ gi// dpyid kyi rgyal mo nyid sprul shes rab bzang*// paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan nā ro'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bo lho brag pa// de yi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mtshur ston dbang*// 'khon ston chen po gad pa kīrti'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'gro ba'i 'dren pa bsod nams rin chen dang*// lha mi'i ston pa tshul khrims skyabs kyi mtshan// gang gi mtshungs bral 'phags pa skyabs kyi zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gdams pa'i mnga' bdag gser sding gzhon nu 'od// thams cad mkhyen pa chos sku 'od zer dang*// 'phags mchog dam pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bu ston rin chen grub// thugs sras dam pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang*// mkhas pa'i dbang po tsand+ra kīrti'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos kun dbang phyug ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// sku zhang chen po mkhyen rab chos kyi rje// zla med bla ma rin chen rgyal po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'dren pa kun gtso padma gar gyi dbang*// rgyal ba'i chos tshul mang thos rnam par rgyal// rdo rje'i slob dpon bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zla 'od gzhon nu slar yang nyid sprul pa// rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi byang chub dang*// bka' drin zla bral rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dal 'byor rnyed dka' myur du 'jig 'gyur zhing*// las 'bras mi bslu bde sdug so sor smin// srid zhi'i rgud sangs thar pa mchog thob par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma mchog

/gtan gyi skyabs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod bstod cing*// rdo rje sems gtso bdag sgrib byang ba ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu bo chen po bzhis// lus ngag yid gsum zag bcas nyes sgrib tshogs// bkrus nas rdo rje rnam bzhir rab smin par| |gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhar// gzod nas yongs grub de la der shes par// bcos min bskyed rim brtan po 'char ba ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lus dben sku yi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin ni// gzugs dang rang bzhin rnam shes ting 'dzin gyi// phung sogs don dam stong par rtogs pa ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ngag dben gsung gi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis// bem po'i rlung ni phra rags gsal bar bcas// shes par bsres nas nā da'i sgrar dag par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sems dben thugs kyi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis// sems brtags snang mched thob bcas chos chos bcas// chags grol lam gyi bde stong mthar phyin par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// kun rdzob bden pa mnyam bzhag sgyu ma ni// sbyang dang spog pa'i rim pas sems gsum po// snang mched thob bcas sgyu mar rtogs pa ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rjes thob sgyu ma snang ba rmi lam dang*// bar do sbyang bzung gcig tu byed pa sogs// gnad kyi gdams pas sgyu lus 'byong ba ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// tshe yi tha mar bsu skyel 'pho ba'i lam// sku gsum dang ni btsan thabs nyams len gyis// ma bsgom sangs rgyas myur lam 'byong ba ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// don dam bden pa 'od gsal gdams pa'i lam// mngon byang chub pa phyi dang nang gi gnad// snang gsum stong bzhi'i stong nyid rtogs pa ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de nyid mngon byed bsam gtan rnam pa gnyis// rjes su gzhig dang ril por 'dzin pa yi// chos kun spros med mkha' ltar rab rtogs par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mnyam bzhag 'od gsal chos nyid lam dang ni// ye shes thabs kyi rtags snang rab gsal zhing*// 'dzin bral bde stong 'bras bu smin pa ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin dang gegs bsal zhing*// ngos bzung gnad kyi gti mug rab dag nas// tshogs drug 'dzin bral gsal stong 'char ba ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol| |'chi kha'i 'od gsal rags dang phra ba dang*// shin tu phra ba 'chi ltas ngos bzung nas// 'od gsal gnad kyis sku gsum thob pa ru// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol| |zung 'jug yang dag mthar thug dngos bral ba'i// 'od gsal ngang la gnyis med ye shes skur// ldang ba lugs ldog snang gsum ye shes kyi// rlung dang bcas pa ye shes gnyis med kyi// ngo bo rdo rje 'chang du rab bzhengs pa'i// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/

'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*/ sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /de ltar rim lnga dmar khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'dod gsol dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa zla tshes ltar dkar ba kho nas/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me phag cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa gnyis par rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
